title: LGC Sbeadex Plant Maxi Kit Nucleic Acid Extraction
author: Opentrons
materials: Upload custom labware definition, if needed.
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Select pipette mount and download bundle
steps.instruction: Choose the pipette mount location on the OT‑2 and download the corresponding protocol bundle for the LGC Sbeadex Plant Maxi Kit.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definition (if needed)
steps.instruction: If any of the labware (e.g., NEST 96 Deep Well Plate, SPEX 96 Well Plate, Elution Plate) is not already in the Opentrons labware library, upload a custom definition file before running the protocol.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Import the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons OT‑2 App.

steps.title: Set up deck according to map

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Magnetic Module with a NEST 96 Deep Well Plate
Slot 3: Temperature Module with an Elution Plate

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Using the OT‑2 App, perform calibration of all labware, tip racks, and the P300 multi‑channel GEN2 pipette according to the standard Opentrons calibration workflow.

steps.title: Run the extraction protocol
steps.instruction: Press the “Run” button in the OT‑2 App to start the automated nucleic‑acid purification using the magnetic and temperature modules.
